name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
blurb: Custom cursor that smoothly follows the mouse and rotates with velocity.
description: Replaces the browser cursor with a smooth-following custom cursor using spring physics. Rotates based on velocity direction and scales slightly on movement.
use_when: A desktop-only interactive experience that needs a branded or unique cursor behavior.
avoid_when: On mobile or touch-only devices — the component auto-disables on non-desktop.
a11y: Desktop-only feature using pointer events. Does not affect keyboard navigation.

props.name: springConfig
props.type: {damping: number; stiffness: number; mass: number; restDelta: number}
